criteria.intent: Deliver an exact-main source analysis and honestly labeled plan review.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing Basic and current RI/catalog/coupling checks validate current source/navigation freshness. Actual dated plan/self-review inspection remains distinct from implementation review.

criteria.intent: Move meaningful blocks upward into settled native positions during downward reading.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY executes serialized controller boot/down/up/tall/jump/one-shot/active-cap/local-stagger cases. Exact rendered desktop/narrow Day/Night review checks visible whole-block movement and final positions; unit tests alone do not approve appearance.

criteria.intent: Preserve native geometry, scroll range, semantics and readable paint during entry.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY tests stable-shell/bottom safety decisions and hidden-row treatment; ENTRY-DELIVERY verifies unchanged semantic route markup and raw HTML budget. The focused entryScenario browser replay compares native, armed, three active and settled rectangles, text, links, width, range and actual bottom, with ink/paper synchronization. Geometry/visual gates inspect actual browser evidence.

criteria.intent: Compose entry with current router, cached DOM and archive lifecycles.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY exercises stale callback rejection, repeated mount/disposal, deferred archive landing, hidden rows and reflow. Shared navigation/archive source checks and focused browser journeys verify actual arrival, interruption, cached-route reuse, filters/anchors/history. The external lifecycle gate evaluates these on current source.

criteria.intent: Keep first-fold, restored, focused, reduced, failed and printed content immediately readable.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY exercises visible boot/restoration, root versus target focus, find shortcut, Off/hold/failure/readiness/unsupported/errors, hidden/print/pagehide/pageshow paths. Browser checks verify keyboard/anchors/find and no-Canvas/reduced output; device/visual evidence remains separate.

criteria.intent: Bound and measure added entry work without changing existing budgets.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY caps active animations at six, bounds sibling delay and clears stale tasks/listeners. Focused active-frame browser replay measures scene layout-pass stability and original geometry; existing motion collector supplies raw callback/paint/idle/transition samples against unchanged budgets. Unit/source success alone does not establish rendering smoothness or physical iPad cost.

criteria.intent: Keep canonical source/style ownership and coherent hosted/offline generation.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY-DELIVERY executes the composed navigation bundle, preserves semantic markup and raw HTML limit, verifies exact shared Color consumption, immutable dependency invalidation and coherent failure. BASIC/STYLE-GUARD/RI checks cover their documented scope; pinned format/lint/source suites and generation plus CS01-CS10 review establish remaining architecture evidence.

criteria.intent: Maintain one linked execution route and reconcile exact-source acceptance honestly.
criteria.automated_scope: Current deterministic shared and entry checks supply source evidence. Exact GitHub head/CI/preview binding, independent implementation review, actual issue checkbox reconciliation and later delivery decisions remain external gates; no automated pass authorizes closure or deployment.

criteria.intent: Hold the reading camera stationary and sequence optical centering, forward/reverse travel and restored reading framing.
criteria.automated_scope: CAMERA-TRAVEL executes actual lifecycle across scroll/reflow/history/room routes, optical centering and staged/pause/interruption cases; shared router propagation and no whole-plane flight helpers are exercised. Browser/current visual/device and matching cost admission remain external. The approved bounded amendment verifies independent 400 ms centering, fixed 1000 ms transit and 350 ms restoration legs, preserving actual arrival and interruption ownership; late paints remain inside the camera-source/destination interval.

criteria.intent: Depart and assemble individual opaque content blocks in the route direction around the completed camera journey.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY exercises viewport-bounded route-block states, direction, cancellation and readable fallback. CAMERA-TRAVEL tests complete router awaits for outgoing blocks, final camera restoration and incoming assembly; stale sessions, late motion changes and all five route travel use the same owner. Existing browser checks inspect staged active geometry with no opacity/depth transform; independent/device/visual review remains separate. The approved bounded amendment uses one 1000 ms departure/arrival envelope independent of route and row count, with 700 ms overlapping directional row movements and a 300 ms stagger span (a single row uses the full envelope). Native peers and separators share timing and clearance, reverse starts are bottom-first. Exact plans, event completion and fixed camera legs retain raw readiness and verified presentation accounting under unchanged execution-cost guards; cancelled/watchdog outcomes never receive animation credit.

PLAN-REVIEW.description: Inspect exact-main source reasoning, target inventory, ordered execution and the separate honestly labeled self-review. Verify geometry/overflow, actual-arrival/cached-DOM/archive, accessibility and bounded-cost treatments, proposed parameter status and original planning scope. A source check cannot approve prose usefulness; independent implementation review remains separate.

RUNTIME-CHECKS.description: Inspect the current mapped serialized entry behavior, shared delivery and source/profile checks together with focused browser geometry/lifecycle evidence. Missing, failed or stale checks remain pending; no source presence test supplies behavior acceptance.

VISUAL.description: Inspect the exact implementation at desktop/narrow Day/Night and focused Safari/WebKit intermediate frames: whole blocks rise and settle, sharp text/backdrops/focus remain readable, no double entry/late cascade, all routes and bottom work. Physical iPad smoothness remains separately observed; do not conflate emulator or self-review with device/independent proof.

GEOMETRY.description: Inspect actual active and settled browser geometry evidence for stable shells/markers/first Writing row, range/bottom/width/wrapping, backdrop/title/focus envelope and no internal scroll container. Compare entry enabled versus disabled on the same candidate.

LIFECYCLE.description: Inspect actual current-source route/archive behavior including pre-departure suspend, actual completed-flight resume, stale serial/callback rejection, cached route reuse, filters/history/anchors/resize/font/bfcache and explicit disposal. Revalidate shared owners in #41/#49; a page-ready notification does not itself prove arrival.

READABILITY.description: Inspect immediate first/restored/anchor/focus/find readability and keyboard controls, runtime preference/hold/failure/hidden/print transitions and complete native/no-JS output. Keep motion preference with the current owner and do not invent browser-find support.

COST.description: Observe matching current-source bounded source/hosted scroll/cold/CPU/route measurements and raw failures under unchanged budgets. Confirm bounded active resources, no scene-layout pass per entry frame, no new perpetual RAF and no permanent archive layer promotion. Record source/profile/device limits honestly.

STYLE-REVIEW.description: Record independent implementation review of applicable CS01-CS10, stable semantic wrappers/grid/paint ownership, closure-safe shared hosted/offline source, lifecycle/disposal, bounded work, meaningful tests and generated output. Guard success proves only its documented subset; plan self-review does not satisfy independent runtime review.

DELIVERY.description: Record one issue69-linked PR and exact Refs commits, current-head CI/preview/source report, actual whole-AC checkbox reconciliation and independent/visual/device gates. On 11 October the maintainer approved the bounded preview continuation and explicitly authorized rebase, publication, staging and merge. Current main requires exact-head source admission and two-host staging before merge. Production and remaining release gates stay separate.
